object.name: evi.softclip~
object.description: A quick all purpose and efficient soft clipper. <o>evi.softclip~</o> does not have all the options of <o>evi.hardclip~</o> or <o>evi.clip~</o>. It aims to be an easy <o>tanh~</o> replacement to drop in to audio chains. The algorithm is a 2nd order antiderivative antialiasing tanh-like function. At high input gains the behaviour is less tanh-like as it folds.
object.discussion: This object is for all those MSP users who use [<o>tanh~</o>] in their audio chains. You should never do this - it destroys your audio and aliases like hell. Use <o>evi.softclip~</o> or <o>evi.clip~</o> instead. It can anti-alias large gain inputs whilst retaining the soft clipping functionality you seek.
